name: SmartLift Optimizer
author: saqlainahmad

sections.description:
SmartLift Optimizer gives you practical tools to speed up your site without bloating: lazy-load images, basic cache clear, DB cleanup, JS defer and optional HTML minify.

Features

  • One-click Clear Cache (flush object cache if available)
  • Image lazy-load for content images
  • Database cleanup (revisions, trashed posts, expired transients)
  • Defer JS and basic HTML minify options
  • Clean, modern admin UI with tabs
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/smartlift-optimizer.
  2. Activate it from Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Open SmartLift Optimizer menu for settings.
sections.faq:
Does it replace full-page caching plugins?

No. This is lightweight tooling. You can use it beside dedicated cache plugins.
